name: Tmc2209 → Chopconf
description: Change the chopper settings at runtime. `toff` and `tbl` apply in both chopper modes, `hstrt` and `hend` set the SpreadCycle hysteresis. The driver defaults work for most motors. See the `CHOPCONF` register and the SpreadCycle section in the datasheet for tuning.

config_entries.label: Hend
config_entries.description: The hysteresis end value, `0` to `15`, for -3 to 12. The power-up value is `0` (-3). The sum of `hstrt` and `hend` (as the datasheet values) must not exceed 16. This is checked when both are set to fixed values in the same action.

config_entries.label: Hstrt
config_entries.description: The hysteresis start value added to `hend`, `0` to `7`, for 1 to 8. The power-up value is `5` (6).

config_entries.label: Tbl
config_entries.description: The comparator blank time, `0` to `3`, for 16, 24, 32 or 40 clock cycles. The datasheet recommends `0` or `1` for most motors. The power-up value is `2`.

config_entries.label: Toff
config_entries.description: The chopper off time, `1` to `15`. The slow decay phase lasts 24 + 32 × `toff` clock cycles. `1` only works with `tbl` set to `2` or higher. This is checked when both are set to fixed values in the same action. Without an `enn_pin`, the driver is disabled by setting the off time to `0`. While the motor is disabled, the new value is stored and written on the next enable. The power-up value is `3`.
